records.title: Analysis of Ecological and Environmental Data I
records.header: QERM 514 Analysis of Ecological and Environmental Data I (4)
records.text: QERM 514 Analysis of Ecological and Environmental Data I (4) Overview of generalized linear models (GLMs) and generalized linear mixed models (GLMMs), and their use in ecology and environmental science. Building and analysis of models, along with inferential methods and philosophy. Statistical software R used throughout. Offered: Sp.
